name: Sword in Stone
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Tap the knight to get oil from his uniform.
Tap the chef’s roasted meat to get cooking fat.
Tap the water bucket to clean the sword base.
Tap the butter on the window ledge.
Tap the lantern to get oil fuel.
Tap the guard’s hair to get grease.
Tap the pine nuts to get plant oil.
Tap the eggs to use egg white as lubricant.
Tap the wizard’s staff to reduce friction.
Tap the boy to pull out the sword and finish the level.
